targetSet.effectRole: GPU particle system + fluid simulation + cursor splat injection

effectArchitecture.engine: Active Theory 'Hydra' (hydra-thread.js workers for spline data)

mouseSplat.description: Screen-space splat of velocity at mouse position into fluid texture

curlNoise.description: Analytic curl noise with 3D potentials and closed-form derivatives (Bridson 2007)

particleSystem.description: GPU particles updated in transform feedback FBO, following fluid flow + mouse strength
particleSystem.mouseCoupling: vec3 flow = texture(tFluid, screenUV).xy; pos += flow * 0.0001 * HZ * uMouseStrength * texture(tFluidMask, screenUV).r

renderPasses.description: 9 identical programs (prog19-prog27) for rendering computed particles to screen

layers.mechanism: Draw screen-blended velocity patch at mouse position (point/prevPoint) into fluid texture with specified radius and color. Cubic ease-out falloff.
Navier-Stokes: advection, divergence, pressure solve, gradient subtraction, vorticity, with curl noise force. Mouse-injected velocity propagates through this multi-pass solver.

GPU particles sample tFluid at screen-projected position. Flow direction scaled by uMouseStrength (mouse velocity magnitude), modulated by tFluidMask (fluid valid region). Force pushes particles in flow direction: `pos += flow * 0.0001 * HZ * uMouseStrength * tFluidMask.r`
